This maize plot of mine in the North East is on rented land, so I must make it count. The rains here in the savanna are short, and maize without fertilizer gives poor yield, so I will buy NPK and top-dress with urea as I have done before. I will also spread what manure I can gather from my animals, and I will buy improved seed from the agro-dealer because good seed with fertilizer pays back the cost. My sons and I will do most of the work, but at planting and weeding I will hire a few hands to keep up with the rains.
